BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to liability protection for landlords; and addinga new section to chapter 59.18 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 59.18 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A landlord who rents to a registered sex offender is immune fromcivil liability for damages caused by the tenant.
